title: Lower the characteristic-four connector floor bound to N(4) ≤ 20; the known nine-source walk does not extend (no new κ)
body:
## Result

For the unsigned dirty connector of #4231 (k immutable sources, all 2^k − 1 binary-mask outputs, calls `B_j: z += B_j x_j` and `A_m: y_m += A_m z`), let N(c) be the largest k at which the floor c(k + 2^k − 1) is attained. #4248 proved 9 ≤ N(4) ≤ 21. This PR shows:

- **Theorem P (scoped proof, instance-checked):** for even c, reduce prefixes mod 2. The readout set of a mask becomes a subset T of at most c inner boundaries whose parity vectors sum to the mask. If T contains an adjacent pair t − 1, t, that pair contributes the unit vector e_(w_t). So 2^k − 1 ≤ P(c, k) = Σ_(i=1..c) C(ck − i, i) + k·Σ_(i=0..c−2) C(ck − 1, i). P(4, 21) = 1,743,531 < 2,097,151, and with #4248's deletion lemma **N(4) ≤ 20**. The same bound gives N(8) ≤ 54 (was 55) and N(2) ≤ 5 (N(2) = 4 is known from #943). It gives no gain at c = 6, 10, 12. For odd c the reduction is unavailable.
- **No extension (exhaustive finite check):** none of the C(40, 4) = 91,390 insertions of a tenth source into #4248's nine-source walk reaches all 1,023 masks. Each has an explicit uncovered mask; 32 distinct witness masks are used. So a ten-source floor walk, if one exists, restricts to no relabelling of that walk.

N(4) remains open in **9 ≤ N(4) ≤ 20**.

**Claim type:** scoped proof plus an exhaustive finite check of one family. This is a search failure for k = 10 only within that family, not an exclusion of k = 10. No new κ, no selected-frontier change, no multiplication theorem.

## Evidence and reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/connector-char4-floor-bounds/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/connector-char4-floor-bounds/verify.py --skip-insertions
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-char4-floor-bounds
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/connector-char4-floor-bounds --check-source-history
```

Marker: `PASS_CONNECTOR_CHAR4_FLOOR_BOUNDS c4_excludes_k>=21 walk9_has_no_ten_source_extension`.

The standard-library verifier re-checks all 511 masks of the nine-source walk. It checks the parity collapse on that walk: all 59,535 inner subsets of size at most four, and all 91,390 boundary 4-multisets reduced mod 2. It tabulates both counting thresholds for c ≤ 12 and k ≤ 200, checking monotonicity. It runs the full insertion sweep and three rejection controls: a swapped walk, the sorted run walk, and a strictness comparison at k = 22. The full run takes about 24 s locally and the `-O --skip-insertions` run under 1 s. All four commands above pass on commit `0dba831b7e138c809f1900ecf51b4716ea99c505`.

## Limitations

- Only the unsigned, immutable-source, complete-call interface of #4231.
- Theorem P is proved for every even c; its thresholds are computed for c ≤ 12.
- The extension check covers one nine-source walk; insertions into other nine-source floor walks are unchecked.
- No consumer, physical prices, admission, dispatch or precision obligations are instantiated.
- No proof-kernel certificate or independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. What is N(4) exactly, within 9 ≤ N(4) ≤ 20? A ten-source floor walk restricts to ten nine-source floor walks, none a relabelling of the known one. Generating inequivalent nine-source walks and running the same sweep is the natural next step.
2. Can the carry condition give a much smaller bound? Writing each stage as u + 2h, a mask also needs Σh + e_2(u) = 0 over F_2 in every coordinate. Heuristically this removes a 2^−k fraction of multisets, but the k conditions are not independent.
3. Does any concrete consumer use a characteristic-four batch of more than four sources at a favourable complete invoice?

## Related open work

- #4248 (floor reached for k ≤ 2c; 9 ≤ N(4) ≤ 21): source of the walk, the deletion lemma and the multiset bound. Its multiset thresholds 7, 14, 22, 30, 38, 47, 56, 65 for c = 2..9 are recomputed here and agree, checked numerically. This PR lowers its c = 4 upper bound from 21 to 20.
- #4231 (five-source connector in every characteristic): source of the interface and floor. No number is recomputed.
- #4232 and #4250 (F3, every source count; seven sources fail): odd characteristic, so Theorem P does not apply. The c = 3 multiset threshold 14 agrees with #4232's, checked numerically.
- #4236, #4249, #4233, #4241: one-source counts, depth-three chains and signed tariffs study different demands or alphabets; no number overlaps.

## CI notes

All checks pass on head `0dba831b7e138c809f1900ecf51b4716ea99c505`: `plan` in 2m50s and the registered package `replay` in 1m35s ([run 39504149784](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39504149784)). No failures or reruns. Every registered command also passed locally first.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Builds on #4248, #4231 and #4232 and on Ross Richardson's #943 interface and prefix-readout criterion. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Apache-2.0.
